name: MASER BARRAGE
about: The C example MASER BARRAGE rebuilt in blocks, three stages deep: the Maser target 5 times in a ball starts it (10 the second time, 15 the third). OPEN FIRE is the C's chain (Left ramp, Right ramp, Building, each within the window; a barrage pays 5M x the multiplier into the pot, up to x5); CROSSFIRE puts the three powerline tanks in line and fires the Maser target (10M x); GODZILLA IN THE SIGHTS aims at the Big loop and fires at the Godzilla target, three direct hits for the pot twice over. Cash the pot at the right scoop after any stage; failing pays a quarter.
lost: The start counts every Maser target hit this ball, with no 250 ms debounce, and the chain's shots have none either: a ball rattling in the Left ramp's entrance can count twice (the C counted one a quarter second).

The next shot's blink quickens once a second as its window closes (the C every tick), and the HUD shows the multiplier as 2 where the C showed X2. The window's seconds ride on the line (SHOOT THE RIGHT RAMP IN 18) where the C had a WINDOW counter.

Every window is 20 s and the same every start (PAD-658: room to make the shot), where the C's was 7 s, 6 s the second time, 5 s the third, and a second shorter after each barrage (down to 4 s). Only the next shot of the chain is lit: the C lit the other two dim.
Awards say their numbers under the words: LEFT RAMP X over 2  -  NOW THE RIGHT RAMP, where the C said LEFT RAMP X2 over 2,000,000.
The ending's line under the title puts the count last (BEST X3  -  BARRAGES 2) where the C said 2 BARRAGES  -  BEST X3, and says BARRAGES for one too; it counts every jackpot of the three stages.
The ending stays up 3 s, the runtime's: the C kept it 10 s.

The counters are MULTIPLIER, POT and the stage's count (BARRAGES, then VOLLEYS, then DIRECT HITS); the C drew MULTIPLIER, WINDOW, BARRAGES (a barrage now pays into the pot, where the C scored it at once).
The countdown's 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 callouts are gone (the blocks say only ten seconds and time up).

Godzilla Premium/LE and Pro 1.16 only (a Pro 1.15 has no switch shots): the C also ran on a Pro 1.15. It played the game's Insert chase at the start and Colour fade at the end, with its own shows where the game had none; the blocks run its own shows (Maser start, Maser won, Maser lost and seven more) on every title instead.

The blocks pack keeps its own FINAL WARS ledger in shared variables ('maser played', 'maser won'), which the blocks FINAL WARS reads: the C FINAL WARS does not read them, and the blocks FINAL WARS does not read the C's ledger.

intro.what: Night Tokyo street: a maser dish tank rolls up, then the tank line takes aim and the first beam fires

loop.what: Night Tokyo battle: maser tanks roll and fire, blue beams strike Godzilla in showers of sparks (fast run of shots, dark)

barrage.what: A volley of blue maser beams fires and hits Godzilla, erupting in sparks

broken.what: Godzilla's ray hits a tank, which explodes in a fireball

won.what: Maser dishes fire; blue beams strike Godzilla, who staggers in sparks and smoke

lost.what: Tanks blasted by lightning amid a sea of fire (the attacker is Megalon, not Godzilla)

crossfire.what: A column of JSDF tanks rolls past through the dust, a Maser tank with its glowing emitter coming through in the middle of the line, at 0:42:21.

volley.what: Run of shots at night: Maser tanks in a city street fire a volley of blue lightning beams, then a Maser dish fires over the soldiers and the beams burst on Godzilla by the burning TV tower, at 1:21:54.

final.what: Godzilla walks straight toward the camera through billowing smoke above the city, front on and in the sights, at 0:44:31.

direct.what: Fire bursts on Godzilla's chest, then Maser lightning beams strike him in a cloud of smoke and sparks as he rears up, at 0:37:09.

cashout.what: A column of tanks rolls away down a highway at night as the camera rises over them toward the city lights, at 0:58:38.

music.what: Riichiro Manabe's score, the final battle (bed finder: final 0.806, loop chroma 0.865)

barrage.what: a Maser volley hitting Megalon and the blast (broadband onset at 0:43:09.8)

broken.what: Megalon's cry as it shrugs the attack off (harmonic roar cpp 0.34)

volley.what: Two crackling, hissing blasts of a Maser cannon firing its blue beam into the night, at 1:35:01.

aim.what: A rising electric whine as a Maser cannon's coils glow orange, charging up in the rain, at 1:24:22.

direct.what: Godzilla roars in close-up as he rears up in the smoke after the barrage hits him, at 0:44:10.

cashout.what: The heavy grinding clank of tank treads and engines as the big Maser vehicles roll out, at 0:58:13.

final.what: Akira Ifukube's brisk military march as the Super X3 sorties from its hangar, no dialogue, at 1:16:45.
